name: Planes Method
aliases: RealityEngine Volume Rendering with CPU Compositing
definition: A volume rendering algorithm that utilizes 3D texture map hardware to render volumetric datasets, combining texture mapping for resampling with CPU-based raycasting for shading and classification.
summary: The Planes Method is a hardware-accelerated volume rendering technique that resamples volumetric data into planes using 3D texture mapping and performs shading and compositing on the CPU, offering higher image quality than Shear-Warp by avoiding final warping.
